post.description: Creates a new action in SafetyCulture.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

taskId.description:
The unique identifier of the action
If not provided, UUID will be generated server side.

title.description:
Required. Title of the action
Title is limited to only 255 characters max.

collaborators[].description: The collaborators involved into this action.

priorityId.description:
ID of the action's priority
If not set, this action will be stored with the default priority(none).

statusId.description:
ID of the action's status
If not set, this action will be stored with the default status(to do).

createdAt.description: Date and time this action was created.

inspectionId.description:
ID of the inspection the action belongs to
If not set, this action is a standalone action and the inspection ID will
be null.

inspectionItemId.description: ID of the item in the inspection associated with the action

templateId.description:
If a template ID is provided then an inspection ID must be
provided. If not set, this action is a standalone action and the template
ID will be null.

siteId.description: ID of the Site associated with the action.

references[].description: Array of references attached to this action.

assetId.description: ID of the Asset associated with the action

labelIds[].description: IDs of the labels associated with the action.

type.description: The type to create an action in.

fieldValues[].description: Array of custom fields and their values to create with the action.

templateIds[].description: The list of templates to be linked to the action.

post.description: Creates a new issue in SafetyCulture.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

taskId.description:
Optional. The unique identifier of the incident
If not provided, UUID will be generated server side

title.description:
Required. Title of the incident
Title is limited to only 255 characters max

createdAt.description: Optional. Date and time this incident was created

categoryId.description:
Required. ID of the incident's category
If not set, this incident will be stored with the default category(None)

answeredQuestions[].description:
Optional. An array of all, if any, custom questions that have been answered
by the contributor
@deprecated: Use `QuestionAnswer` instead. This was a field used for string
custom questions. We've since moved to structured custom questions in the
`QuestionAnswer` field.

email.description: Optional. The email address of the contributor

media[].description: Optional. Array of media items to be linked to the incident.

siteId.description:
Optional. ID of the site to associate with the incident.
If not provided, no site will be associated with the incident.

name.description: Optional. The name of the contributor

contact.description: Optional. The contact details of the contributor

location.description: The location that the incident occurred at

accessToken.description:
Optional. The access token used to authenticate the request. This field
should be set when following the contributor flow. Otherwise, authenticate
via normal means.

description.description: Optional. Description of the issue (maximum 500 characters).

questionsAndAnswers[].description:
Optional. An array of all, if any, custom questions that have been answered
for this issue.

items[].description:
Optional. The category fields and questions that applied to this incident
when it was created.

occurredAt.description: Optional. Date and time this incident occurred at

assetId.description: Optional. The ID of the asset associated with this incident.

put.description: Updates an action status in SafetyCulture.

connectionId.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

taskId.description: Required. The ID of the action or issue you're updating.

statusId.description:
Required. The ID of the status you're updating the action or issue to.
An issue can be in an "Open" or "Resolved" status, where each status is represented by hardcoded UUID values.
Issue statuses:
- Open: `547ed646-5e34-4732-bb54-a199d304368a`.
- Resolved: `450484b1-56cd-4784-9b49-a3cf97d0c0ad`.

An action can be in a "To do", "In progress", "Complete", or "Can't do" status, where each status is represented by hardcoded UUID values.
Action statuses:
- To do: `17e793a1-26a3-4ecd-99ca-f38ecc6eaa2e`.
- In progress: `20ce0cb1-387a-47d4-8c34-bc6fd3be0e27`.
- Complete: `7223d809-553e-4714-a038-62dc98f3fbf3`.
- Can't do: `06308884-41c2-4ee0-9da7-5676647d3d75`.

modifiedAt.description: Optional. The UTC time and date the modification took place.
